subject: Re: Weekend hiking group
text: Thanks for your note yesterday. I liked your trail idea. The river path looks pretty. It is still new to me. I want to try it. I disagree about one point though. Starting at dawn is too early. My knees wake slowly. They need tea and time. Maybe we can begin later. Nine sounds nicer. I can bring a flask. You can bring the trail map. I checked the weather. It will stay mild. Bring your small hat. The sun feels strong by noon. I can also carry fruit. You can carry the sandwiches. That seems fair. I do not mind the distance. Five miles is fine. I enjoy seeing birds. That is my favorite part. The quiet helps me think. You are good at spotting signs. Please point them out. I can snap a few photos. Then we can pick a cafe. I hope you will forgive my fuss. I am excited anyway.
